ADS AI

RF engineering
Live

AI-powered RF circuit design assistant for the engineering team. Describe what you need in plain English, the agent designs the circuit, simulates it with scikit-rf, plots S-parameters and Smith charts, runs Monte Carlo yield analysis, and exports to Touchstone or SPICE.

What we shipped
  • 12 circuit templates: filters, matching nets, attenuators, dividers, couplers, amps
  • 5 impedance-matching topologies — every match verified S11 < -58 dB
  • Monte Carlo yield + scipy optimization (Nelder-Mead, Powell, Differential Evolution)

How we work

Four stages, six to twelve weeks

Every engagement follows the same disciplined cadence. No mystery, no scope drift.

  1. 01

    Discover

    Workshops with your team. We map the workflows, data, systems, and decisions worth automating.

  2. 02

    Design

    Architecture, prompt patterns, evaluation criteria, and a working prototype against your real data.

  3. 03

    Deploy

    Production rollout with observability, guardrails, audit trails, and bilingual UX.

  4. 04

    Operate

    Continuous evaluation, model updates, and quarterly reviews tied to business KPIs.

Defense & security

Defensive monitoring & decision-support.

Six specialised systems we are scoping or piloting for defense and security operators in the Kingdom. Every system is positioned as defensive, monitoring, or human-in-the-loop decision-support — never autonomous targeting.

DefensiveMonitoringDecision-supportHuman-in-the-loop
Monitoring

AI signal processing

Real-time fusion of radar, ELINT, and SIGINT streams. Deep models classify and de-noise signals; anomaly scoring routes findings to operators.

Monitoring

Radar threat awareness

Tracks fused with ADS-B and intel feeds into one situational picture. Unusual approach patterns flagged for the operator to review.

Defensive

Military health monitoring

Wearable + sensor data (HR, SpO₂, fatigue, heat). Edge models surface medical risk before it becomes critical. Fully on-prem.

Human-in-the-loop

AI targeting & risk assessment

Identifies and scores potential security risks for personnel, locations, and operations. Output is advisory — every action gated by a trained human.

Decision-support

Logistics & command-support

Spare-parts forecasting, supply-chain risk, perimeter surveillance summaries, and a natural-language layer over secure command dashboards.

Defensive

Doctrine & briefing assistant

Cited Q&A over manuals, ROE, and orders in Arabic + English. Air-gapped deployment, full audit trail per question and per source citation.

All defense systems are scoped under 3Lines' role as a Saudi MRO and aerospace partner. We do not build offensive autonomous systems.
Where we're investing

Three pillars driving the AI Division forward

Deliberate investments in compute, models, and people — so the next year of agents we ship is bigger than the last.

01 / 03

Larger compute clusters

Scaling our GPU footprint to train bigger models, run faster inference, and unlock multimodal workloads at production scale across the Kingdom.

Infrastructure
02 / 03

Custom model fine-tuning

Domain-specific fine-tunes for Arabic, defense MRO, government, and finance — purpose-built models that outperform generic LLMs on the work that matters here.

R&D
03 / 03

Defense & military training data

Public datasets barely cover military and defense contexts — especially in Arabic. We're building and curating proprietary corpora for MRO logs, doctrine, sensor feeds, and bilingual operational language so our defense agents can actually be trained on the work they do.
